UPDATE normal_group_creation_item SET current_step = 'CREATING_GROUP', dispatch_stage = 'GROUP_CREATE', dispatch_status = 'SENT', create_command_id = #{commandId}, create_attempt_count = create_attempt_count + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND current_step = 'PREPARING_CONTACTS' AND status = 'RUNNING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM normal_group_creation_item_member member WHERE member.tenant_id = normal_group_creation_item.tenant_id AND member.item_id = normal_group_creation_item.id AND (member.creator_saved_member_status <> 'SUCCESS' OR member.member_saved_creator_status <> 'SUCCESS') )

UPDATE normal_group_creation_item SET group_jid = #{groupJid}, group_subject = #{groupSubject}, create_partial = 0, current_step = 'APPLYING_SETTINGS', dispatch_stage = 'GROUP_SETTINGS_APPLY', dispatch_status = 'SENT', settings_command_id = #{settingsCommandId}, post_attempt_count = post_attempt_count + 1, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND current_step = 'CREATING_GROUP' AND create_command_id = #{createCommandId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND group_jid IS NULL

UPDATE normal_group_creation_item SET status = #{status}, dispatch_stage = 'NONE', dispatch_status = 'NONE', group_jid = CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} = 'CREATING_GROUP' AND #{groupJid} IS NOT NULL AND #{groupJid} <> '' THEN #{groupJid} ELSE group_jid END, create_partial = CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} = 'CREATING_GROUP' AND #{groupJid} IS NOT NULL AND #{groupJid} <> '' THEN 1 ELSE create_partial END, settings_status = CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} = 'APPLYING_SETTINGS' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE settings_status END, creator_leave_status = CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} = 'LEAVING_GROUP' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE creator_leave_status END, last_event_id = #{eventId}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND current_step = #{expectedStep} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND ( (#{expectedStep} = 'CREATING_GROUP' AND create_command_id = #{commandId}) OR (#{expectedStep} = 'APPLYING_SETTINGS' AND settings_command_id = #{commandId}) OR (#{expectedStep} = 'LEAVING_GROUP' AND leave_command_id = #{commandId}) OR (#{expectedStep} = 'PREPARING_CONTACTS') )

UPDATE normal_group_creation_item SET status = 'RUNNING', dispatch_status = 'SENT', dispatch_stage = CASE #{expectedStep} WHEN 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN 'GROUP_CREATE' WHEN 'APPLYING_SETTINGS' THEN 'GROUP_SETTINGS_APPLY' WHEN 'LEAVING_GROUP' THEN 'GROUP_LEAVE' ELSE dispatch_stage END, create_command_id = CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} = 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN #{commandId} ELSE create_command_id END, settings_command_id = CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} = 'APPLYING_SETTINGS' THEN #{commandId} ELSE settings_command_id END, leave_command_id = CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} = 'LEAVING_GROUP' THEN #{commandId} ELSE leave_command_id END, settings_status = CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} = 'APPLYING_SETTINGS' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE settings_status END, creator_leave_status = CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} = 'LEAVING_GROUP' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE creator_leave_status END, create_attempt_count = create_attempt_count + CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} = 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, post_attempt_count = post_attempt_count + CASE WHEN #{expectedStep} IN ('APPLYING_SETTINGS', 'LEAVING_GROUP') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, last_event_id = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND current_step = #{expectedStep} AND status = 'FAILED' AND #{expectedStep} IN ('CREATING_GROUP', 'APPLYING_SETTINGS', 'LEAVING_GROUP')

UPDATE normal_group_creation_task task SET success_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status = 'CREATED' ), failed_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status IN ('CREATED_PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'RESULT_UNKNOWN') ), status = CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status NOT IN ('CREATED', 'CREATED_PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'RESULT_UNKNOWN')) > 0 THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status = 'CREATED_PARTIAL') > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status IN ('CREATED_PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'RESULT_UNKNOWN')) = 0 THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status = 'CREATED') = 0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE task.id = #{taskId} AND task.deleted_at IS NULL
